The 1850 US figure in 2011 international dollars is roughly $4,000 (plausible range $3,800–4,400), but I recalled it rather than checking the Maddison Project Database, so verify the exact number there. The team note's "about a dollar a day" framing doesn't fit this figure: $4,000 a year is about $11 a day, so the 1850 US was well above bare subsistence. Exact values differ across Maddison vintages, so use the current database for a precise number.
